# Later source learning binds retained records

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Records read through a family of explanations: for every type of records, meanings and worlds, where each bearing record is explained by some family world with the target, a form resolves to the target exactly when every other meaning of a repertoire without repeats is ruled out by some bearing record that no family world with that meaning explains. For earlier naming records reread through acquired production routes: a retained packet’s record offers exactly the atoms of the worlds, a learned route under an admitted fault, that produce its reports; for every memory, fault envelope, form and target whose packets of the form are each produced by some learned world with the target, the binding view resolves the form to the target exactly when every other meaning is ruled out by some packet of the form that no learned world with that meaning produces, and unique binding is then correct (the existing coverage theorem follows for every record). The naming-before-calibration history (retrospective 36) is an instance: its two retained packets separate both atoms, so every finite encoded sequence is interpreted as the assembly of its atoms. After a later real route change the earlier packet is produced by no learned world with its target, the failing side; a finite response has a separate witness.

Canonical source: [RetrospectiveBinding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/RetrospectiveBinding.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Grouping, atomic operations, form recognition, channel identity and reporting-symbol decoding are available; the four-route family, calibration probes and fault envelope are explicitly supplied.
- General correctness requires calibration from the declared route and that same route to cover each relevant earlier naming record, with its actual disturbance admitted. Historical applicability is not a known answer supplied to the learner.
- The local witness retains prior grouping/composition training and charges reception/calibration. Previously formed reporting-decoder training costs are not newly joined; computation and storage maintenance receive no separate charge.

Record contents persist while their current evidential role can change. bindingView receives neither the actual route nor the novel target. Controlled probes are not identical to children’s familiar naming; psychological realization, source-identity formation, temporal scope and evolutionary origin need further correspondence.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1: 20 new theorems / 36 declaration audits; 284 inherited theorems / 513 audits separately rebuilt. New dependencies: 11 empty, 10 propext only, 15 propext with Quot.sound. Inherited closure includes Classical.choice. Primary-source comparison and author counterreview; no new empirical reanalysis or independent-agent acceptance.

Does not prove all source judgments, natural language, developmental mechanism, complete energy accounting, consciousness or evolutionary psychology. It does not additionally compose prior movement selection with social report production into one history or identify this algorithm in children.

- Missing packets, partial calibration, channel misindexing, finite support and the inherited omitted joint effect preserve distinct failures; a real route change allows accurate late calibration to misinterpret earlier content. [RetrospectiveBinding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/RetrospectiveBinding.lean)
